title: DOSBox (DOS prompt)
description: An empty DOS PC with the C:> prompt to try DOS commands like DIR, VER or MEM.
author: DOSBox team, js-dos (Alexander Guryanov)

title: Tiny Core Linux 17.1
description: Tiny Linux with a graphical desktop, boots from CD. Programs cannot be installed without internet.
author: Robert Shingledecker, Tiny Core team

title: KolibriOS 0.7.7
description: A complete graphical operating system written in assembler that fits on a single floppy. With games, an editor and demos.
author: KolibriOS team

title: ReactOS 0.4.15 (live CD)
description: Free operating system that looks like Windows and aims to run Windows programs. Live CD, no installation. Starting takes a few minutes while the CD is loaded bit by bit.
author: ReactOS project

title: SkiFree
description: The 1991 classic: ski down the slope, dodge obstacles and run from the yeti.
author: Chris Pirih
license: offered for free by the author (no explicit licence)
note: Included as an example in the Boxedwine web release.

title: OpenTTD 15.3
description: Free remake of Transport Tycoon Deluxe: build railways, roads, ships and planes. With the free OpenGFX graphics. Takes a moment to start.
author: OpenTTD team

title: Castle of the Winds 1
description: Classic role-playing game from 1992 based on Norse mythology. Part 1: "A Question of Vengeance".
author: Rick Saada (SaadaSoft), published by Epic MegaGames
license: freeware, released by the author (no explicit licence)

title: Castle of the Winds 2
description: The sequel "Lifthransir’s Bane". You can bring along a character from part 1.
author: Rick Saada (SaadaSoft), published by Epic MegaGames
license: freeware, released by the author (no explicit licence)

title: Keen Dreams
description: Platformer by id Software (1991): Commander Keen fights the vegetables of King Boobus Tuber in a dream. Press 5 in the start menu to play.
author: id Software, published by Softdisk
license: shareware, free to share (LICENSE.DOC in the ZIP)

title: Star Wars: Dark Forces (Demo)
description: Shooter by LucasArts (1994) starring Kyle Katarn, English shareware demo with the first level.
author: LucasArts
license: shareware demo, free to share (README.TXT in the ZIP)

title: Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis (Demo)
description: Adventure by LucasArts (1992), English playable demo. Play with the mouse, keyboard shortcuts are in READ.ME.
author: LucasArts
license: demo, free to share (READ.ME in the ZIP)

title: Boppin’ (Shareware)
description: Puzzle game from 1994: throw blocks at their matching counterparts. Shareware episode, already installed and set up for Sound Blaster.
author: Accursed Toys, published by Apogee
license: shareware, sharing without charge allowed (VENDOR.DOC in the ZIP)

title: T-Rex 64
description: Endless runner modelled on the Chrome dino, rewritten for the C64.
author: Maciej Małecki

title: Horizontal Shooter
description: Side-scrolling space shooter for the SNES: steer your ship with the D-pad and shoot with B (on the keyboard: arrow keys and X).
author: Marcus Rowe (undisbeliever)

title: Nova the Squirrel
description: Homebrew platformer with a squirrel that copies the abilities of its enemies.
author: NovaSquirrel

title: µCity
description: City-building game in the style of SimCity, written in assembler for the Game Boy Color.
author: Antonio Niño Díaz
